name: @sure/client
//openapi-fetch: Held below 0.17 deliberately, and packages/api-tests must match. 0.17 wraps every response in openapi-typescript-helpers' `Readable<T>`, whose array branch (`T extends (infer E)[] ? Readable<E>[]`) collapses tuples: StoredTaxScale's `brackets: [number | null, number][]` comes back as `(number | null)[][]`, so assigning a response to `Schemas["StoredTaxScale"]` stops compiling. Upstream bug, fix open but unmerged (openapi-ts/openapi-typescript#2673, #2842) — raise the cap once one lands, don't widen the tuple to get around it.
